# Special-point mock blocks
# Place these blocks inside an NBT template to mark semantic positions.
# The mod extracts them at load time (MockBlockExtractor) and processes
# them at placement time (MockBlockProcessor). See docs/systems/ for
# per-type processing semantics.
#
# Generated automatically — do not edit.

millenaire:mock_marker          Generic marker (spawn point, waypoint, etc.)
millenaire:mock_facing_marker   Directional marker (door facing, etc.)
millenaire:mock_chest           Chest spawn location
millenaire:mock_soil            Farmable soil zone
millenaire:mock_source          Quarry source: placed as its material, mined by
                                villagers (mining "sourceSubtype")
millenaire:mock_free            Cost-free block: placed as its material, not
                                counted in the building cost
millenaire:mock_tree_spawn      Tree planting location
millenaire:mock_animal_spawn    Animal spawn zone
millenaire:mock_decor           Decorative item placement

# Generic markers (data-extensible) — the subtype is a registry id held by
# the block's block entity ("payload"), not a blockstate. In creative mode,
# right-click the placed marker with an item to set it (sneaking or not);
# with an empty hand, right-click shows the current payload. Pick-block
# (middle click) copies the payload.

millenaire:mock_generic_soil         Soil for any farmland crop. Payload: the
                                     seed item id (right-click with a seed whose
                                     block is a crop or a stem), e.g.
                                     mymod:blueberry_seeds. The builder places
                                     dirt.
millenaire:mock_generic_tree_spawn   Tree planting location for any sapling.
                                     Payload: the sapling item id, e.g.
                                     minecraft:cherry_sapling.
millenaire:mock_generic_animal_spawn Pen spawn for any mob. Payload: the entity
                                     type id from any spawn egg, e.g. minecraft:goat.
                                     Monsters are accepted: they are persistent,
                                     tagged millenaire_pen and exempt from the
                                     village mob sweeps (they still attack).
millenaire:mock_generic_source       Quarry source of any full block. Payload: the
                                     blockstate placed, e.g. minecraft:tuff (right-
                                     click with the block; its placement orientation
                                     is kept). Special point subtype: the block id.
millenaire:mock_generic_free         Cost-free block of any single-cell block.
                                     Payload: the blockstate placed, e.g.
                                     minecraft:oak_log[axis=x]. Both refuse blocks
                                     with a block entity (chests...) and two-part
                                     blocks (doors, beds, tall plants). Sneak to
                                     place a block against them without changing
                                     their payload.

# Authoring rules for generic content:
#  - Crops: the gathering type JSON matches the payload through
#    "soilSubtype": "<seed id>", with "cropBlock" / "seedItem". Farmland crops
#    only (CropBlock / StemBlock, Millenaire seeds and grapes included; no
#    rice or sugar cane). Provision the first seeds (starting goods) or
#    omit "seedItem"; harvests supply more. Subtype-less flower types never
#    plant on generic soil. A generic soil subtype that no gathering type
#    references is logged at server start (typo check).
#  - Trees: "subtypeFilter": "<sapling id>" (optional). The ground under a tree
#    spawn is grass; a sapling needing other ground will not survive. Modded logs
#    outside minecraft:logs are never chopped.
#  - Animals: breeding / slaughter JSONs take the full "animalType" id. The pen
#    cap is per entity type ("cow" and "minecraft:cow" share it); breeding and
#    slaughter cap on all animal spawn points of the building together.
#  - Sources: a "mining" JSON names the block id in "sourceSubtype"
#    (e.g. "minecraft:tuff"; "stone" does not match "minecraft:stone"). A
#    generic source that no mining type names is logged at server start.
#    Sources and free blocks cost nothing; a payload naming an absent mod
#    places nothing (warned once).
#  - Upgrade levels: at the same position, a later level's generic point
#    replaces the earlier one; removing a marker does not remove the point.
#  - An empty or malformed payload is skipped with a warning; the template
#    does not fall back to its _special_points sidecar.
#  - Unknown ids (missing mod) still load; the points are skipped at runtime
#    with one warning per id.

# Total: 12 mock block types.
